newsitem.title: UK: Ldn Freight - Decline is extended, indices drop.
newsitem.headline: Ldn Freight - Decline is extended, indices drop.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) dropped 12 points on Tuesday to stand at 1,382, the lowest since last November 5, as the dry cargo freight market continued to ease from a seasonal peak.
Brokers cited continued weakness in the Panamaxes and an apparent turn lower in Capers.
The Atlantic grains market also looks unpromising at the moment for Handy-sized vessels although these remain fairly steady elsewhere.
The new Baltic Handy Index was down six at 1027.
Brokerage CIS said Handy Size values had begin to come off in the Pacific and that the Atlantic grain market "can be described as a graveyard.
"South American business has also dwindled with all eyes on new crop activity in April and whether this will be the saving grace for the market in the Atlantic".
Brokers reported Keoyang booked NOL Canopus 52,500 heavy grain NoPac to S.Korea Feb 11/20 at $12.00.

Also in the grains trades, Athena fixed 50,000 tonnes barley Bahia Blanca/Turkey 3-7/2 $16.25 fio 6,000/10,000 to Soufflet and Grand View was fixed for 1,942,314 cubic ft grains USGulf/Denmark prompt $527,270 lumpsum fio eight days shinc to Continental.
Timecharter business included Captain George Tsangaris 61,349 dwt taken by Albatross for delivery Skaw early Feb for trip via Baltic redelivery Singapore/Japan range at $14,000 daily.
